verses.1: And these are the laws and regulations that Jehovah your God has commanded you to teach you, so that you may obey them when you live in the land you are going to inherit.
verses.2: So that you may fear the LORD your God and keep all His commandments and laws. These are the commands I have given you, for yourself, your sons, and your grandchildren, throughout your entire life. And so that your days may be long.
verses.3: And you shall hear what Israel has done, and you shall keep to doing what is good for you. You shall also prosper greatly, just as the LORD, your God, has spoken. You shall possess land that is rich in milk and honey.
verses.4: Hear, Israel! The LORD our God is one.
verses.5: And love the LORD your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your strength.
verses.6: And these are the words that I command you today, in your own mouth.
verses.7: And you shall teach your children, and speak to them at your home, while you walk along the road, and when you lie down, and when you get up.
verses.8: And they shall be tied to the altar by your hand, and they shall become offerings before your eyes.
verses.9: And write them on the doors of your houses and on your gates.
verses.10: And it shall be that when Jehovah your God brings you into the land that was promised to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, He will give you great and good cities. These cities you did not build yourselves.
verses.11: And houses full of all the good things that you didn’t create. And valleys full of waterfalls that you didn’t dig out. And fruits and olives that you didn’t plant or eat from.
verses.12: Guard this, so that you do not forget Yahweh, who brought you out of the land of Egypt from the house of servants.
verses.13: Fear the LORD your God, and serve Him alone. And worship Him in His name.
verses.14: Do not follow other gods after the Lord. Do not worship those gods of the nations around you.
verses.15: For the LORD your God is a jealous God; he will not forgive your sins. He will destroy you from above the face of the earth.
verses.16: Do not try to test Jehovah, your God, as you have tried Him in the past.
verses.17: You shall keep the commands of the LORD your God, his laws and decrees.
verses.18: And you have done what is right and good in the eyes of Jehovah, so that it may be good for you. You have come and inherited this good land, which Jehovah has blessed for your ancestors.
verses.19: May He drive away all your enemies from before you, as Jehovah says.
verses.20: For your son may ask you tomorrow, “What are the laws and regulations that Jehovah our God has commanded you to follow?”
verses.21: And you said to your son, “We were servants of Pharaoh in Egypt. But Jehovah brought us out of Egypt with great power.”
verses.22: And Jehovah gave them great and evil plagues in Egypt, at the hands of Pharaoh and all his houses, for our eyes to see.
verses.23: And He brought us out of there, so that He could give us the land that was promised to our ancestors.
verses.24: And Jehovah commanded them to carry out all these laws, so that they might honor Jehovah our God. This is for our good, so that we may live forever, just as we do today.
verses.25: And righteousness will be ours, if we keep all these commandments before our God, Jehovah. As He has commanded us.
